quotes.quote: Adjust the seat height to a level that positions the machine handles approximately level, or near level, with your shoulders. Position your feet firmly on the floor or foot pads to stabilize your body.
quotes.closest: Adjust the seat height to a level that positions the machine handles approximately level, or near level, with your shoulders. Position your feet firmly on the floor or foot pads to stabilize your body.

quotes.quote: Sit upright and extend your arms to grasp the handles without rounding your shoulders forward. Adjust the position the chest pad to contact your chest lightly.
quotes.closest: Sit upright and extend your arms to grasp the handles without rounding your shoulders forward. Adjust the position the chest pad to contact your chest lightly.

quotes.quote: Depress and retract your scapulae (pull shoulders back and down), maintain a neutral wrist position (i.e., wrist in line with your forearms) and attempt to hold these positions throughout the exercise.
quotes.closest: Depress and retract your scapulae (pull shoulders back and down), maintain a neutral wrist position (i.e., wrist in line with your forearms) and attempt to hold these positions throughout the exercise.

quotes.quote: Flex (bend) your elbows and pull them towards your chest keeping your elbows close to the sides of your body. Continue to maintain a neutral wrist position, and contact with your chest against the chest pad.
quotes.closest: Flex (bend) your elbows and pull them towards your chest keeping your elbows close to the sides of your body. Continue to maintain a neutral wrist position, and contact with your chest against the chest pad.

quotes.quote: Continue pulling until your elbows pass the sides of your body. Pause momentarily then slowly return to your starting position, allowing your arms to move forward and elbows to extend (straighten) in a slow, controlled manner
quotes.closest: Continue pulling until your elbows pass the sides of your body. Pause momentarily then slowly return to your starting position, allowing your arms to move forward and elbows to extend (straighten) in a slow, controlled manner

quotes.quote: Avoid leaning back and arching your low back and attempt to minimize any movement of your head during the movement.
quotes.closest: Avoid leaning back and arching your low back and attempt to minimize any movement of your head during the movement.

quotes.quote: Additionally, reduce unnecessary stresses into your low back by avoiding any backwards lean during the pull movements.
quotes.closest: Additionally, reduce unnecessary stresses into your low back by avoiding any backwards lean during the pull movements.

quotes.quote: Maintain your upright trunk position and avoid forward rounding of your scapulae (shoulder blades).
quotes.closest: Maintain your upright trunk position and avoid forward rounding of your scapulae (shoulder blades).

quotes.quote: Allowing your shoulders to round forward as your arms extend will allow you to pull with more force. However, learn how to perform a pulling motion without scapulae (shoulder blade) movement first before introducing shoulder movement.
quotes.closest: Allowing your shoulders to round forward as your arms extend will allow you to pull with more force. However, learn how to perform a pulling motion without scapulae (shoulder blade) movement first before introducing shoulder movement.

quotes.quote: Flex (bend) your elbows and pull them towards your chest, but try to flair your elbows out from your sides, keeping them as level with your shoulders as possible.
quotes.closest: Flex (bend) your elbows and pull them towards your chest, but try to flair your elbows out from your sides, keeping them as level with your shoulders as possible.
